periods.time: First school term, selection battle opening
periods.label: 落第骑士的正式初战
titles: 破军学园一年一班学生骑士

status.relationship: becomes Stella Vermillion's boyfriend and rival

appearance.overview: Gentle-looking, modest Japanese boy with a trained, lean fighter's body.

physical.build: lean, hardened by severe daily training

attire.combat: uses the black katana Device Intetsu

distinctive: broad trained back noticed by Stella

personality.summary: Courteous, self-effacing and stubbornly resilient; he refuses to surrender his dream despite institutional and family rejection.
values: prove human worth beyond innate talent
fears: his years of effort being meaningless
hurting people who believe in him
desires: win the Seven Stars Sword Art Festival
become someone who can tell others not to give up
face Stella again at the summit
flaws: can miss his own fear and exhaustion
personality.inner_conflict: He wants to prove himself as a knight while carrying trauma from family rejection, school suppression, and public humiliation.

decision_pattern.combat: observe, decode, then counter; uses Ittou Shura only when the match must end immediately

address_pattern.stella: initially 史黛菈同学, later 史黛菈

quote_samples: 我将以我的最弱，击破你的最强。

mannerisms: bows or apologizes even when not at fault
habits.daily_routine: Runs roughly twenty kilometers each morning with sprint intervals.
quirks: poor at handling aggressive romantic advances

background.upbringing: Born into an elite Blazer family but treated as nonexistent because of F-rank magic; locked away from family gatherings and training.

education.year: repeating first year due to previous administration blocking practical credits

formative_events: Kurogane Ryoma encouraged him not to give up during a childhood snowstorm
left the Kurogane house four years before vol-01
was bullied and denied official practice in his first year at Hagun
background.pre_story: Endured family and institutional pressure intended to keep him from graduating as a magic knight.

relationships.stella-vermillion: Roommate, first defeated opponent, later girlfriend and promised final rival.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Younger sister who loves him intensely; he sees her as precious family.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: New friend who recognizes his suppressed pain.
relationships.shizuya-kirihara: Former classmate and bully; defeated in first selection battle.
relationships.shinguji-kurono: Chairwoman who restored his chance to fight.

knowledge: Stella's sword rhythm after copying it
Kirihara's combat psychology after enduring his arrows
secrets: His Ittou Shura destroys normal limits for one minute but leaves him nearly helpless afterward.
periods.summary: Ikki begins the volume as Hagun's F-rank repeat student and alleged Worst One. After an accidental first meeting with Stella, he defeats her in a duel by using Ittou Shura. He reconnects with Shizuku, helps resolve a Rebellion hostage crisis, then overcomes trauma and Kirihara's invisible attacks in his first official selection battle. Stella's public defense restores his spirit, and he ends the volume by confessing to her and promising to meet her in the Seven Stars final.

key_events.summary: Accidentally walks in on Stella changing in their assigned dorm room.
Defeats A-rank Stella using Ittou Shura after decoding her swordsmanship.
Cuts off Smile's Judgment Ring hands and helps free hostages.
Endures Kirihara's invisible arrows, learns his psychology, and wins the first selection match.
Confesses to Stella and promises to fight her again at the summit.
